description: This file defines a wizard for tracking production moves in an Odoo (OpenERP) module, including functions for retrieving moves, tracking lines, and managing wizard states.

classes.name: wizard_track_move
classes.description: Wizard interface class managing the states for tracking production moves.

methods.name: _get_moves
methods.description: Retrieves production moves and prepares XML form for tracking.

methods.name: _track_lines
methods.description: Creates lots and updates stock moves based on tracking selections.

methods.name: _next
methods.description: Determines the next state of the wizard based on production status.
